input.summary: Vendor Nilagiri Phytolabs submits commercial terms for glycerin (Rs 118/kg), rosemary extract (Rs 7000/kg, MOQ 100 kg), and caffeine (Rs 1650/kg with full-lot condition), plus freight (~Rs 9/kg), 50% advance payment, 3-week delivery, and 12-month shelf life; it also makes unverified reliability claims and says certificates are pending and COA comes only after order.
